short_summary: ClarionLoop is evaluating Redwood hosted API for high-QPS RAG search across a 2.2M-doc KB. Primary needs: low-latency embeddings+reranking, predictable cost per query, SOC2/SAML compliance. Requesting a hosted POC that demonstrates 6k sustained QPS with model-fallback and billing estimate for production.
technical_requirements:
- Index size: ~2.2M short docs, nightly diffs.
- Peak QPS: sustained 6k, spikes to 12k.
- Latency SLO: p50 < 80ms, p95 < 180ms, p99 < 250ms for end-to-end (embeddings lookup + rerank + generation).
- Budget target: blended cost <= $0.003/query.
- Model stack: open quantized embedding model + lightweight reranker (cross-encoder) and fallback to smaller decoder when needed.
- Routing: NA region primary; fallback to multi-region with failover.
- Security: SSO (SAML), audit logging, CMK support for embeddings, contract-level SOC2 attestation.
poc_success_metrics: 1) Demonstrate ingest of 2.2M docs within 48h using provided scripts. 2) Sustained 6k QPS over 30m with p99 < 250ms. 3) Cost projection <= $0.003/query at projected volumes. 4) SAML SSO test in staging. 5) Evidence of automatic model-fallback working under constrained capacity.
commercial_notes: Interested in a 12-mo committed plan for Dedicated if hosted POC meets latency + cost targets; otherwise will evaluate Redwood Optimize add-on to tune batching/caching. Procurement timeline: Apr 2026 if POC successful. AE pushed preliminary ARR band 50-150k; legal requests around data residency clause.
